blind.description: A stylized wooden coffin or casket resting horizontally on the floor. It has a classic hexagonal/tapered coffin shape with a faceted lid featuring a raised cross emblem running down the center. Metallic studs or bolts border the lid edges, and ring-pull handles are attached to the sides. All surfaces are continuous, solid, and clean, with no shards, holes, or floating elements. The model rests flat on its base directly on the floor with no plinth.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it appears as a tapered hexagonal wooden coffin shape with a prominent raised cross along the center of the lid, studded edges, and side handles barely visible protruding from the flanks.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.2 to 1.5 ft high lying down, about 2 ft wide at the widest shoulder, and around 5 to 5.5 ft long (comparable in length to the 5 ft 9 in figure's height).
